INT. CARTOGRAPHER'S WORKSHOP - DAY

A grand workroom with a HIGH CEILING crossed by thick, dark EXPOSED BEAMS. Maps cover every surface -- pinned to walls, rolled in cubbies, spread across wide drafting tables. The smell of ink and old parchment hangs in the air.

FELIX ADLER (40s, meticulous, ink-stained fingers) leans over the largest table, adding detail to an enormous survey map. The lines are drawn in DEEP BLUE INK -- rivers, roads, mountain ridges, all rendered in the same rich blue.

The elevation surveys from the northern pass. As requested.

FELIX

Sable sets the bundle down and studies the map.

SABLE
It is beautiful.

FELIX

He uncaps a fresh quill and dips it in the BLUE INK. The deep blue lines extend across the parchment of the Northern Reaches survey.

INT. CARTOGRAPHER'S WORKSHOP - DAY

A grand workroom with a HIGH CEILING crossed by thick, dark EXPOSED BEAMS. Maps cover every surface -- pinned to walls, rolled in cubbies, spread across wide drafting tables. The smell of ink and old parchment hangs in the air.

FELIX ADLER (40s, meticulous, ink-stained fingers) leans over the largest table, adding detail to an enormous survey map. The lines are drawn in DEEP BLUE INK -- rivers, roads, mountain ridges, all rendered in the same rich blue.

SABLE

FELIX
